title: Cybersecurity Law passed
description: Vietnam's Law on Cybersecurity 2018 created the legal basis for data localisation, later detailed by Decree 53 in 2022.
significance: Set the security-first frame that shapes where user data must sit.

title: NTT and QD.TEK form JV for 6MW Saigon Hi-Tech Park data centre
description: NTT Global Data Centers and Vietnamese distributor QD.TEK announced a JV to build a 6MW IT data centre in Saigon Hi-Tech Park, targeting 2024.
significance: Early foreign operator entry, done through a local partner before the 2023 Telecom Law removed ownership caps.

title: Decree 53 details data localisation
description: Decree 53/2022/ND-CP (effective 1 Oct 2022) requires local firms to store Vietnamese users' personal and generated data in Vietnam; foreign firms must localise and open a local office within 12 months only after a Ministry of Public Security written request tied to violations.
actor: Government of Vietnam (Ministry of Public Security)
significance: Creates baseline local storage demand and a standing lever over foreign platforms.

title: PDP8 approved
description: Decision 500/QD-TTg approved Power Development Plan VIII with 150,489 MW of 2030 capacity.
significance: First master plan of the net-zero era; quickly judged too small for new demand.

title: Northern power shortages and rolling cuts
description: From mid-May to mid-June 2023 drought cut hydro output, coal supply fell short and weak north-south lines stranded southern surplus; unmet demand hit 900 GWh. World Bank estimated losses of about US$1.4bn (0.3% of GDP).
significance: The defining energy-security shock for any northern data centre pitch.

title: US-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
description: The US and Vietnam raised ties to a comprehensive strategic partnership; semiconductors are a major two-way trade category.
significance: Gave Vietnam top-tier diplomatic status with Washington while keeping the same status with Beijing.

title: New Telecommunications Law passed
description: The National Assembly passed a new Law on Telecommunications treating data centres and cloud as registered services with no foreign ownership cap; most provisions effective 1 Jul 2024, data centre and cloud provisions 1 Jan 2025.
significance: Opened data centres to 100% foreign ownership, replacing the old joint-venture route.

title: Viettel opens 30MW Hoa Lac data centre
description: Viettel inaugurated its 14th data centre, 30MW and over 2,400 racks, in Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park; network total 87MW.
significance: Then Vietnam's largest DC; showed the state military telco leads the build-out.

title: FPT and Nvidia sign US$200m AI factory MoU
description: FPT and Nvidia signed an MoU in Hanoi for a US$200m AI factory with H100 GPUs and cloud GPU services.
significance: First big Nvidia-linked compute pledge in Vietnam.

title: STT GDC and VNG plan 60MW HCMC2
description: Singapore's STT GDC and Tencent-invested VNG formed a JV for a second Tan Thuan data centre of up to 60MW IT, due H1 2026.
significance: Largest planned foreign-partnered colo at the time; later abandoned (Aug 2026).

title: Huawei weighs Vietnam cloud data centres
description: Huawei said it was considering Vietnam data centres once demand reaches a threshold; no site or amount.
significance: Only Chinese hyperscaler signal found; no commitment.

title: DPPA decree takes effect
description: Decree 80/2024 lets users consuming at least 200,000 kWh a month buy renewable power directly, by private line or via the national grid from projects of 10MW or more.
significance: Gives data centres a legal route to contract green power.

title: 500kV circuit-3 line to the north inaugurated
description: The 519km Quang Trach to Pho Noi line (about US$897m) doubled north-central-to-north transfer capacity from 2,500MW to 5,000MW, built in just over seven months after the 2023 shortages.
significance: Direct fix for the grid bottleneck that caused the 2023 cuts.

title: Google reported to weigh first Vietnam hyperscale DC
description: Reuters-sourced reports said Google was weighing a hyperscale data centre near HCMC, possibly live by 2027; Google did not comment.
significance: Signalled US hyperscaler interest; not confirmed by Nov 2026 in sources reviewed.

title: National Assembly restarts Ninh Thuan nuclear project
description: Lawmakers approved restarting the Ninh Thuan nuclear project with EVN as investor and Russian and Japanese partners, citing energy security.
significance: Long-dated baseload option; not relevant to data centres before the 2030s.

title: Nvidia signs AI centre deal with Vietnam government
description: Nvidia agreed with the government to set up an AI R&D centre and an AI data centre, and said it bought Vingroup's VinBrain; no amounts given.
significance: Highest-profile US AI pledge; financial terms undisclosed.

title: FPT AI Factory with thousands of H100s readied
description: FPT showed its Vietnam AI Factory with thousands of Nvidia H100 GPUs, with services from January 2025; site and MW not disclosed.
significance: First large domestic GPU cloud.

title: US AI Diffusion rule leaves Vietnam outside Tier 1
description: The Biden-era AI Diffusion framework was announced; Vietnam was not on the Tier 1 or Tier 3 lists, so it fell into capped Tier 2 (inferred from tier definitions). It was rescinded before compliance began.
significance: Would have capped GPU imports; rescinded before compliance.

title: First LNG-fired plant connects to grid
description: Nhon Trach 3, part of PV Power's 1,624MW Nhon Trach 3 and 4 LNG complex (about US$1.4bn), was connected to the national grid; both units began commercial operation on 5 Jan 2026 (VnEconomy).
significance: Start of imported LNG in the power mix.

title: Revised PDP8 approved
description: Decision 768/QD-TTg raised 2030 capacity to 183 to 236GW, with large solar, wind, BESS (10 to 16.3GW) and 4 to 6.4GW nuclear for 2030 to 2035.
significance: Planning response to AI and industrial demand; delivery is the open question.

title: Viettel breaks ground on 140MW HCMC data centre
description: Viettel began a 140MW, about 10,000-rack data centre in Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, billed as Vietnam's first above 100MW.
significance: Step change in scale; state firm leads hyperscale.

title: US rescinds AI Diffusion rule
description: Commerce announced rescission two days before compliance, issuing guidance on chip diversion red flags for data centre customers.
significance: Removed the Tier 2 cap on Vietnam; diversion scrutiny remains.

title: US-Vietnam tariff deal: 20% plus 40% on transshipment
description: Trump announced a deal setting a 20% tariff on Vietnamese goods, down from 46% threatened in April, and 40% on transshipped goods aimed largely at China.
significance: Put Vietnam's role as a China-plus-one hub under US scrutiny.

title: G42-led consortium proposes US$2bn HCMC AI data centre
description: UAE's G42 with FPT, VinaCapital and Viet Thai proposed a US$2bn hyperscale AI factory in HCMC to the Prime Minister.
actor: G42; FPT; VinaCapital; Viet Thai Group
significance: First Gulf AI capital aimed at Vietnam.

title: Samsung C&T and CMC sign US$1bn HCMC DC MoU
description: Samsung C&T and CMC agreed in Seoul to build an HCMC High-Tech Park hyperscale DC, phase 1 30MW (US$250m), later phases above 100MW.
significance: Korean builder-capital enters alongside a domestic operator.

title: US-Vietnam reciprocal trade framework
description: Joint statement kept a 20% rate with possible zero rates for some goods and promised cooperation on export controls; at a meeting with Trump the same day PM Pham Minh Chinh asked for removal from US D1/D3 control lists.
significance: Export-control access became part of the trade bargain.

title: G42 framework deal with FPT and Viet Thai
description: G42 and the FPT-Viet Thai consortium signed a framework to build and run large Vietnam data centres, backed by consumption commitments of up to US$1bn.
significance: Moved the Gulf-backed plan from proposal to framework; no site or MW yet.

title: US Supreme Court strikes IEEPA tariffs
description: The ruling ended the 20% reciprocal tariff; a temporary 10% Section 122 tariff followed and expired after 150 days. Average US tariff on Vietnamese goods fell to about 16% (Global Trade Alert).
significance: Loosened tariff pressure, though new Section 301 tariffs followed.

title: Singapore-led hyperscale licences in Saigon Hi-Tech Park
description: On 25 Apr 2026 HCMC granted investment certificates to Singapore-led Evolution DC (52MW IT, over US$508m) and Starmason, a Sembcorp Development and BB Holdings JV (60MW IT, over US$480m).
significance: Proof the Telecom Law opening is producing foreign-owned capacity.

title: AWS Local Zone Hanoi goes live
description: AWS made a Hanoi Local Zone generally available, an edge extension of its Singapore region, not a full region.
significance: First US hyperscaler cloud zone in Vietnam (AWS had CDN edge sites since 2022); still no full US cloud region.

title: US Section 301 tariff of 12.5% on Vietnam
description: After the Section 122 tariff lapsed, Vietnam faced a 12.5% Section 301 tariff (forced-labour enforcement case); MOIT estimated it covers about 37% of exports to the US. Reciprocal deal still unsigned.
significance: Trade terms with Washington remain unsettled.

title: STT GDC exits planned 60MW HCMC2
description: STT GDC agreed to sell its 65% of the HCMC2 site company to VNG for about US$18.3m; lease to 2041 judged too short for hyperscale.
significance: Shows land tenure limits on Vietnamese hyperscale.

title: China-linked speakers offer to build AI factories in Vietnam
description: At a Vietnam-China AI forum in Hanoi, a Shenzhen-based speaker proposed Chinese equipment, GPUs, energy and capital for joint AI factories, with Vietnam giving land and power. No government commitment reported.
actor: Hong Kong Chamber of Commerce in Shenzhen; Sunwah Group
significance: Signals Chinese interest in Vietnamese compute alongside US and Gulf players.

title: National AI Strategy approved
description: Government approved a national AI strategy naming AI data centres and computing as a pillar; targets top-three Southeast Asian AI R&D rank by 2030.
significance: Gives policy cover for state and private compute build-out.

title: C4ADS alleges Nvidia GPU diversion through Vietnam
description: A C4ADS report alleged 50 shipments of restricted Nvidia GPUs (about US$13.4m) were diverted via Vietnam, India and Malaysia to Hong Kong and China in 2023 to 2025. Allegations; no Vietnamese firms named.
significance: Diversion risk could shape US chip licensing for Vietnam.
